verdict.rationale: Sill keeps data off any server: there is no account, and screen and keystrokes travel only between your own devices. It also documents deleting pairing data: you can remove paired devices in Settings › Devices on the Mac, or Forget a paired Mac on the iPhone/iPad. Logs, though, sit in Library/Logs with no documented retention or clearing control, and deleting them would be a manual user workaround. Missing for 10: documented retention settings for logs and local data, an in-app clear/delete-all-data control, and independent corroboration of what is stored locally.
